headline: US Judge Approves Google's $10M Acquisition of Defunct Spirit Airlines Data
summary: A US bankruptcy judge approved Google's $10 million acquisition of internal business data from defunct Spirit Airlines after Alphabet's Google agreed to implement additional privacy protections.
why: Corporate asset sales in bankruptcy proceedings allow distressed companies to monetize remaining intellectual property or data assets to satisfy creditors.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Acquiring bankrupt asset data expands technological or business capabilities for the tech conglomerate.
